doc: Browser-tab helpers whose behavior is shared by direct and run-realm handles.

methods.name: url
methods.doc: Return the current page URL.

methods.name: title
methods.doc: Return the current page title.

methods.name: goto
methods.doc: Navigate the page.

methods.name: back
methods.doc: Navigate to the previous session-history entry.

methods.name: forward
methods.doc: Navigate to the next session-history entry.

methods.name: reload
methods.doc: Reload the current document.

methods.name: pushState
methods.doc: Perform client-side navigation without loading a new document.

methods.name: frames
methods.doc: List the current main and child frames.

methods.name: dialog
methods.doc: Return the current pending JavaScript-dialog state.

methods.name: handleDialog
methods.doc: Explicitly settle the pending confirm or prompt.

methods.name: setDialogs
methods.doc: Change the automatic JavaScript-dialog policy at runtime.

methods.name: observe
methods.doc: Capture a structured accessibility observation.

methods.name: ariaSnapshot
methods.doc: Capture a Playwright-format ARIA snapshot.

methods.name: a11y
methods.doc: Run an axe-core accessibility audit across the page frame tree.

methods.name: webmcpList
methods.doc: Discover experimental page-provided WebMCP tools.

methods.name: webmcpInvoke
methods.doc: Invoke one experimental page-provided WebMCP tool.

methods.name: webmcpEvents
methods.doc: Poll the experimental WebMCP catalog change log.

methods.name: screenshot
methods.doc: Capture the page or one matching element; tracked captures return change metadata.

methods.name: diffScreenshot
methods.doc: Compare the current viewport against a saved PNG and display a highlighted diff.

methods.name: pdf
methods.doc: Print the page to PDF and return its absolute path.

methods.name: extract
methods.doc: Extract readable page content.

methods.name: click
methods.doc: Click the element matching selector.

methods.name: dblclick
methods.doc: Double-click the element matching selector.

methods.name: hover
methods.doc: Hover the element matching selector.

methods.name: focus
methods.doc: Focus the element matching selector.

methods.name: check
methods.doc: Set a checkbox, radio, or ARIA switch.

methods.name: uncheck
methods.doc: Clear a checkbox, radio, or ARIA switch.

methods.name: keyDown
methods.doc: Press a keyboard key without releasing it.

methods.name: keyUp
methods.doc: Release a keyboard key.

methods.name: mouseMove
methods.doc: Move the pointer to viewport coordinates.

methods.name: mouseDown
methods.doc: Press a mouse button at the current pointer position.

methods.name: mouseUp
methods.doc: Release a mouse button at the current pointer position.

methods.name: clickAt
methods.doc: Click the element under viewport coordinates.

methods.name: wheel
methods.doc: Dispatch a raw wheel event.

methods.name: highlight
methods.doc: Draw a temporary inert outline around a matching element.

methods.name: type
methods.doc: Type text into the element matching selector.

methods.name: fill
methods.doc: Replace the value of the element matching selector.

methods.name: press
methods.doc: Press a keyboard key, optionally on a matching element.

methods.name: scroll
methods.doc: Scroll by page-relative or matching-element deltas.

methods.name: drag
methods.doc: Drag from one selector or point to another.

methods.name: select
methods.doc: Select values in the matching select element.

methods.name: uploadFile
methods.doc: Upload files through a matching file input, chooser trigger, or drop zone.

methods.name: waitForUrl
methods.doc: Wait for the current URL to match a string or regular expression.

methods.name: text
methods.doc: Return the first matching element's rendered text, or null.

methods.name: html
methods.doc: Return the first matching element's inner HTML, or null.

methods.name: value
methods.doc: Return the first matching form element's current value, or null.

methods.name: attr
methods.doc: Return one attribute from the first matching element, or null.

methods.name: count
methods.doc: Count elements matching a selector.

methods.name: box
methods.doc: Return the first matching element's page-coordinate bounds, or null.

methods.name: styles
methods.doc: Return selected computed styles for the first matching element, or null.

methods.name: isVisible
methods.doc: Report whether the first matching element is visible.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.doc: Report whether the first matching element is enabled.

methods.name: isChecked
methods.doc: Report whether the first matching element is checked.

methods.name: waitForText
methods.doc: Wait until text appears in the document body or one matching element.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.doc: Evaluate a function or source string in the page.

methods.name: waitFor
methods.doc: Wait for an actionable selector and report whether it appeared.

methods.name: emulate
methods.doc: Merge runtime emulation overrides, or return the current state when omitted.

methods.name: devices
methods.doc: List Puppeteer known-device names.

methods.name: clipboardRead
methods.doc: Read plain text from the page clipboard.

methods.name: clipboardWrite
methods.doc: Write plain text to the page clipboard.

methods.name: clipboardCopy
methods.doc: Copy the page's current selection.

methods.name: clipboardPaste
methods.doc: Paste the page clipboard into the focused control.

methods.name: cookies
methods.doc: Return cookies visible to the current page or supplied URLs.

methods.name: setCookies
methods.doc: Install cookie objects, a raw Cookie header, a cURL dump, or a JSON cookie array.

methods.name: clearCookies
methods.doc: Delete all current-page cookies or selected cookie names.

methods.name: storage
methods.doc: Return all pairs from a Web Storage area, or one selected value.

methods.name: setStorage
methods.doc: Set one or several Web Storage values.

methods.name: clearStorage
methods.doc: Clear one Web Storage area.

methods.name: saveState
methods.doc: Save Playwright-compatible cookies and current-origin storage, returning the absolute file path.

methods.name: loadState
methods.doc: Restore cookies and per-origin storage from a saved state file.

methods.name: addInitScript
methods.doc: Register JavaScript for every future document and return its identifier.

methods.name: removeInitScript
methods.doc: Remove a previously registered document-start script.

methods.name: initScripts
methods.doc: List document-start scripts registered through this tab helper.

methods.name: waitForDownload
methods.doc: Wait for the next completed download.

methods.name: downloads
methods.doc: List completed downloads for this tab.

methods.name: console
methods.doc: Read captured page console messages.

methods.name: errors
methods.doc: Read captured uncaught exceptions and failed requests.

methods.name: clearConsole
methods.doc: Clear captured page console messages, errors, and overflow state.

methods.name: traceStart
methods.doc: Start recording a Chrome DevTools Protocol trace.

methods.name: traceStop
methods.doc: Stop recording and save the trace to disk, returning the absolute file path.

methods.name: profileStart
methods.doc: Start capturing a V8 CPU profile.

methods.name: profileStop
methods.doc: Stop CPU profiling and save the profile to disk, returning the absolute file path.

methods.name: metrics
methods.doc: Sample layout, DOM node, listener count, and heap metrics.

methods.name: route
methods.doc: Intercept network requests matching a glob pattern.

methods.name: unroute
methods.doc: Remove request interception routes matching pattern, or all when omitted.

methods.name: routes
methods.doc: List currently active route patterns.

methods.name: requests
methods.doc: List captured HTTP network requests.

methods.name: request
methods.doc: Fetch full detail for a captured request, including response body when available.

methods.name: clearRequests
methods.doc: Clear recorded network requests.

methods.name: harStart
methods.doc: Start recording HTTP traffic to a HAR file.

methods.name: harStop
methods.doc: Stop HAR recording and save to disk, returning the absolute file path.

methods.name: allowedDomains
methods.doc: List domains currently permitted for page navigation and subresources.

methods.name: vitals
methods.doc: Sample Web Vitals metrics (LCP, FID, CLS, TTFB, FCP).

methods.name: reactEnable
methods.doc: Enable the React DevTools hook on this tab.

methods.name: reactTree
methods.doc: Capture the mounted React component tree.

methods.name: reactInspect
methods.doc: Inspect props, state, and hooks for a React component.

methods.name: reactRenders
methods.doc: Read recent React render timeline entries.

methods.name: reactSuspense
methods.doc: List pending and resolved React Suspense boundaries.

methods.name: recordStart
methods.doc: Start recording user interactions on this tab.

methods.name: recordStop
methods.doc: Stop interaction recording and return recorded actions as a script string.

methods.name: recordRestart
methods.doc: Clear recorded actions and restart interaction recording.

methods.name: recording
methods.doc: Report whether interaction recording is active.
